name: salesforce-code-quality
description: Analyze and govern Salesforce code quality with Salesforce Code Analyzer and the Well-Architected framework: set up and troubleshoot Code Analyzer, run security/performance/best-practice/style scans across engines (PMD, ESLint, CPD, RetireJS, Flow, SFGE, ApexGuru), author custom Regex/PMD/ESLint rules, and run a multi-pillar Well-Architected architecture review with file:line evidence. Use for static analysis, code scanning, quality gates, custom lint rules, or a holistic architecture/Well-Architected audit — includes a read-only architecture-review agent.
